result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a paved sidewalk on the residential side and a complete lack of one on the opposite side, which consists of a vacant lot. The roadway is in poor condition with faded crosswalk markings at the intersection and no dedicated traffic control, while parked cars create potential sightline issues.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a paved walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on uneven dirt and grass.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street adjacent to the vacant lot

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The crosswalk markings at the intersection ahead are extremely faded, making them less visible to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parking
hazards.description: Continuous on-street parking on the right side blocks sight lines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the row houses

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a standard paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a continuous and safe pedestrian path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the intersection crosswalks using high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility by preventing parking too close to the corner.

result.summary: The image shows a residential mid-block environment with row houses directly fronting a concrete sidewalk. While a continuous walkway is present, it lacks a buffer from the roadway and contains some debris that partially obstructs the path.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Construction materials and debris are leaning against the building and occupying part of the sidewalk width.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right, in front of the red-doored building.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or planting strip between the sidewalk and the active travel lane.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Install a furniture/planting zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearance
interventions.description: Enforce regulations to keep the public right-of-way clear of debris and private property storage.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians at night.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features narrow sidewalks with significant obstructions, including utility poles placed directly in the walking path. The roadway lacks clear lane markings and the visible intersection has very faded crosswalks, indicating a lack of prioritized pedestrian infrastructure.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are located in the center of the narrow sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to step into the roadway or onto unpaved surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the street in the foreground and middle ground

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalks
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk at the intersection is extremely faded, reducing its visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Lane Markings
hazards.description: The absence of clear lane lines can lead to unpredictable vehicle movements and lane drifting.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings at the intersection to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalks and relocate utility poles to provide a clear, ADA-compliant walking path.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a sidewalk in poor physical condition with significant cracking and uneven surfaces. The street lacks a buffer between the walkway and the roadway, and the presence of a vacant lot creates a gap in the active street frontage.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The concrete sidewalk is heavily cracked and uneven, creating a significant trip hazard for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Trash bags are piled on the sidewalk, narrowing the available walking path.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, next to the building steps

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Leveling
interventions.description: Repave the sidewalk to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface and eliminate trip hazards.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving vehicles.
